new_people.name: Bradshaw
new_people.quote: The footman came at the summons
new_people.intro: Footman summoned to guard the laboratory door

events.text: Poole tells Utterson he saw a masked figure in the cabinet.
events.quote: if that was my master, why had he a mask upon his face?

events.text: Utterson suggests Jekyll suffers a deforming disease and hides his face.
events.quote: Your master, Poole, is plainly seized with one of those maladies

events.text: Poole insists the masked thing was not Jekyll but a dwarf.
events.quote: that thing was not my master, and there’s the truth

events.text: Utterson resolves to break in the cabinet door.
events.quote: I shall consider it my duty to break in that door

events.text: Poole and Utterson agree to break in together.
events.quote: Why, you and me, sir

events.text: Poole fetches an axe and suggests Utterson take the kitchen poker.
events.quote: There is an axe in the theatre

events.text: Utterson warns Poole they are placing themselves in peril.
events.quote: you and I are about to place ourselves in a position of some peril

events.text: Poole says the masked figure was Mr. Hyde.
events.quote: why, yes, I think it was!

events.text: Utterson says he once spoke with Hyde.
events.quote: I once spoke with him

events.text: Poole describes Hyde as giving a cold, thin feeling.
events.quote: you felt in your marrow kind of cold and thin

events.text: Utterson summons Bradshaw and orders him to guard the laboratory door.
events.quote: Call Bradshaw.

events.text: Poole and Utterson wait in the theatre and hear pacing footsteps.
events.quote: they sat down silently to wait

events.text: Poole says the walker weeps like a woman or lost soul.
events.quote: Weeping like a woman or a lost soul

events.text: Utterson demands to see Jekyll and threatens brute force.
events.quote: I demand to see you

events.text: The voice begs Utterson for mercy.
events.quote: for God’s sake, have mercy!

events.text: Utterson recognizes the voice as Hyde's and orders the door down.
events.quote: it’s Hyde’s!

events.text: Poole strikes the door five times with the axe until it bursts.
events.quote: Poole swung the axe over his shoulder

events.text: They peer in and find the contorted body of Edward Hyde.
events.quote: beheld the face of Edward Hyde

events.text: Utterson concludes Hyde is a self-destroyer by the crushed phial.
events.quote: he was looking on the body of a self-destroyer

events.text: Utterson says they must now find Jekyll's body.
events.quote: it only remains for us to find the body of your master
